scope.purpose: Validate and construct JSON-safe product-session report metadata without audio capture, playback, association selection, waveform scoring, or retained-evidence mutation.
scope.primary_product_claim: Finite target-specific association and recall for an authorized project owner under a separately frozen session protocol.

nonclaims: No waveform score is computed by this contract.
No recording, playback, or device discovery occurs.
No prototype is selected or association trained.
No product-session threshold or real-session protocol is established.
